title: Look-ahead calendar: the month view (follows “Look ahead to”; the stops at the top right open it on its own)
description: The risk register (KQL function MiniBankLookahead in law-appmon) as an Outlook-style month: 5 weeks from the Monday of the look-ahead date. Red days = the next 7 days, orange days = 8-30 days. Filled chip = known date (time shown); outlined chip with ~ = trend forecast (straight line, only dates within 2 years); white outline = prep reminder 7 days before a known date. Right: next up, later and what is carried over (bitten, overdue or lapsed). Follows the board setting “Look ahead to”; read-only; it shows the risks, it fixes nothing. Added 18 Nov 2026 (approved by the lab owner).

// Look-ahead month view (Grafana Canvas) on the board MiniBank - Look-ahead: one row of fields for the fixed spots of the panel.
// READ-ONLY: reads only the Look-ahead risk register MiniBankLookahead() (the same function as the radar, tiles and register table).
// The board setting 'Look ahead to' (variable ff: 0, 7, 14, 30 days or a date yyyy-mm-dd) moves the date; nothing else changes.
// Known dates stay exact; capacity and speed dates come from the same straight-line trends; guard: only dates within 2 years.
let dn = dynamic(['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat']);
let mn = dynamic(['','Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']);
let nowW = now() + 7h;
let ffs = trim(@'\s+', tostring(${ff:singlequote}));
let ffn = todouble(ffs);
let ffd = todatetime(ffs);
let A0 = case(isnotnull(ffn), nowW + 1d * max_of(0.0, min_of(ffn, 730.0)), isnotnull(ffd), ffd + 12h, nowW);
let A = max_of(nowW, min_of(A0, nowW + 730d));
let FF = A > nowW + 1h;
let fdd = (t: datetime) { strcat(tostring(dayofmonth(t)), ' ', tostring(mn[getmonth(t)]), iff(getyear(t) != getyear(nowW), strcat(' ', tostring(getyear(t))), '')) };
let fd = (t: datetime) { strcat(tostring(dn[toint(dayofweek(t) / 1d)]), ' ', fdd(t)) };
let th = (n: long) { iff(n >= 1000, strcat(tostring(n / 1000), ',', substring(tostring(1000 + n % 1000), 1)), tostring(n)) };
let nf = (x: real) { iff(x >= 100.0, th(tolong(round(x, 0))), tostring(round(x, 1))) };
let reg = materialize(MiniBankLookahead()
| extend DueW = todatetime(extract(@'due ([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})', 1, Limit)),
         Wd = todouble(extract(@'warning is reached in ([0-9.]+) days', 1, Basis)),
         AboveW = Basis has 'already above the' and Basis has 'warning',
         WarnTxt = replace_string(extract(@'warning ([0-9.]+ [a-zA-Z%]+)', 1, Limit), '.0 ', ' '),
         Lim = replace_regex(replace_regex(Limit, @'\.0 ', ' '), @' \(warning.*$', ''),
         DL = todouble(DaysLeft),
         NowV = todouble(extract(@'^(-?[0-9.]+)', 1, Now)));
let ev = reg
| extend Kinds = case(isnotnull(DueW), dynamic(['due']),
                      Item startswith 'Business transactions P95', dynamic(['warn', 'limit']),
                      Lens in ('Capacity', 'Service') and isnotnull(DL) and DL <= 730.0, dynamic(['limit']),
                      Lens == 'Posture' and Status in ('Act', 'Watch'), dynamic(['carry']),
                      dynamic([]))
| mv-expand K = Kinds to typeof(string)
| extend T = case(K == 'due', DueW,
                  K == 'warn' and AboveW, nowW - 1m,
                  K == 'warn' and isnotnull(Wd) and Wd <= 730.0, nowW + 1d * Wd,
                  K == 'limit' and isnotnull(DL) and DL <= 0.0, nowW - 1m,
                  K == 'limit' and isnotnull(DL) and DL <= 730.0, nowW + 1d * DL,
                  datetime(null))
| where K == 'carry' or (isnotnull(T) and T <= nowW + 730d)
| extend Trend = K in ('warn', 'limit'), P95 = Item startswith 'Business transactions P95'
| extend What = case(
        K == 'warn', strcat('Payments P95 reach the ', WarnTxt, ' warning'),
        P95, strcat('Payments P95 reach the ', Lim, ' limit'),
        Item has 'pull token', 'Image pull token expires', Item has 'push token', 'Image push token lapses',
        Item startswith 'Password expires', 'Oracle password expires', Item has 'evaluation', 'Windows evaluation ends',
        Item has 'certificate', 'Ingress certificate expires', Item startswith 'Oldest', 'Oldest lab data starts to age out',
        Item == 'Node disk used', strcat(Resource, ' disk reaches ', Lim),
        Item == 'Memory used, busiest pod', strcat('Transfer pod memory reaches ', Lim),
        Item == 'Data into Log Analytics per day', strcat('Log Analytics reaches its ', Lim, ' daily cap'),
        Item has 'response', strcat(Resource, ' disk response reaches ', Lim),
        Item == 'Memory in use', strcat(Resource, ' memory reaches ', Lim),
        Item has 'Tablespace', strcat('Oracle tablespace reaches ', Lim),
        Item endswith ' used', strcat(Resource, ' ', replace_string(Item, ' used', ''), ' full (', Lim, ')'),
        Item has 'requests', strcat(Resource, ' ', tolower(Item), ' reach ', Lim),
        Item startswith 'Pods', strcat(Resource, ' reaches the ', Lim, ' limit'),
        Item has 'budget', strcat(replace_string(Item, ' - error budget left', ''), ' error budget used up'),
        Item has 'backup', 'Full backup', Item has 'Windows update', 'Windows updates',
        substring(strcat(Resource, ': ', Item), 0, 40)),
    Short = case(
        K == 'warn', strcat('P95 ', WarnTxt, ' warning'), P95, strcat('P95 ', Lim, ' limit'),
        Item has 'pull token', 'Pull token expires', Item has 'push token', 'Push token lapses',
        Item startswith 'Password expires', 'Oracle password', Item has 'evaluation', 'Windows eval ends',
        Item has 'certificate', 'Ingress cert expires', Item startswith 'Oldest', 'Oldest data ages out',
        Item == 'Node disk used', strcat(Resource, ' disk ', Lim), Item == 'Memory used, busiest pod', 'Transfer pod memory',
        Item == 'Data into Log Analytics per day', 'LA daily cap', Item has 'response', strcat(Resource, ' disk resp.'),
        Item == 'Memory in use', strcat(Resource, ' memory'), Item has 'Tablespace', 'Oracle tablespace',
        Item endswith ' used', strcat(Resource, ' ', replace_string(Item, ' used', ''), ' full'),
        Item has 'requests', strcat(Resource, iff(Item has 'Memory', ' mem', ' CPU'), ' requests'),
        Item startswith 'Pods', strcat(Resource, ' pods'),
        Item has 'budget', strcat(replace_string(Item, ' - error budget left', ''), ' budget out'),
        K == 'carry', iff(Item has 'backup', 'Full backup', iff(Item has 'Windows update', 'Windows updates', Item)), substring(strcat(Resource, ' ', Item), 0, 20)),
    Imp = case(
        K == 'warn', 'payments slower than the warning level', P95, 'the 95 % under 1 s target is missed',
        Item has 'pull token', 'image pulls fail: new or restarted pods cannot start', Item has 'push token', 'no new image pushes (none planned)',
        Item startswith 'Password', 'the app can no longer log on to Oracle: payments fail', Item has 'evaluation', 'the VM shuts down every hour',
        Item has 'certificate', 'clients reject the MiniBank web address', Item startswith 'Oldest', 'trends and back-tests lose their first days',
        Item == 'Node disk used', 'OpenShift removes images and evicts pods', Item has 'busiest', 'the transfer pod restarts out of memory',
        Item has 'Analytics', 'data collection stops until the cap resets', Item has 'response', 'slow storage slows database calls',
        Item == 'Memory in use', 'the machine pages and slows down', Item has 'Tablespace', 'inserts fail: payments fail',
        Item endswith ' used', 'writes stop on that machine', Item has 'budget', 'the service target is missed',
        Item has 'requests', 'new or moved pods stay Pending', Item startswith 'Pods', 'no more pods can start on the node',
        substring(Impact, 0, 60)),
    Prep = case(
        Status in ('Info', 'Planned'), '',
        K == 'warn' or P95, 'find the step that slows payments', Item has 'pull token', 'renew the image pull token',
        Item == 'Node disk used', strcat('free or grow the ', Resource, ' disk'), Item has 'busiest', 'raise the transfer pod memory limit',
        Item has 'Analytics', 'raise the daily cap or trim noisy tables', Item startswith 'Password', 'change the Oracle passwords',
        Item has 'evaluation', 'activate the Windows licences', Item has 'certificate', 'renew the ingress certificate',
        Item has 'response', strcat('check the ', Resource, ' storage'), Item == 'Memory in use', strcat('add memory to ', Resource),
        Item has 'Tablespace', 'grow the Oracle tablespace', Item endswith ' used', strcat('free space on ', Resource),
        Item has 'requests' or Item startswith 'Pods', 'add a node or lower pod requests',
        Item has 'budget', 'freeze risky changes and fix the failures', Item has 'backup', 'take a full backup',
        Item has 'Windows update', 'patch the Windows VMs', 'plan the fix'),
    Age = iff(K == 'carry' and Item startswith 'Days since', NowV + (A - nowW) / 1d, real(null)),
    LimS = replace_regex(replace_string(replace_regex(Limit, @'\.0 ', ' '), 'at most ', ''), @'^1 days$', '1 day');
let evg = materialize(ev
| extend Day = iff(K == 'carry', datetime(null), startofday(T)), AgeR = round(Age, 1)
| summarize N = count(), T = min(T), Res = strcat_array(array_sort_asc(make_set(Resource)), ', '), Status = take_any(Status), Owner = take_any(Owner),
            Lens = take_any(Lens), Item = take_any(Item), Now = take_any(Now), LimS = take_any(LimS), Age = max(Age)
    by What, Short, Imp, Prep, K, Trend, Day, AgeR
| extend What = iff(N > 1, strcat(replace_string(replace_string(What, 'password expires', 'passwords expire'), 'evaluation ends', 'evaluations end'), ' (', N, ')'), What),
         Short = iff(N > 1, strcat(replace_string(Short, 'Oracle password', 'Oracle passwords'), ' (', N, ')'), Short)
| extend d = iff(K == 'carry', real(null), (T - A) / 1d)
| extend Lapsed = K != 'carry' and d < 0.0 and Status in ('Planned', 'Info'),
         Bitten = K != 'carry' and d < 0.0 and Status !in ('Planned', 'Info')
| extend Z = case(K == 'carry' or d < 0.0, 0, d <= 7.0, 1, d <= 14.0, 2, d <= 30.0, 3, d <= 90.0, 4, d <= 180.0, 5, 6)
| extend Col = case(Status == 'Info', '5', Status == 'Planned', '3', K == 'carry', iff(Status == 'Act', '1', '2'), Z <= 1, '1', Z <= 3, '2', '4')
| extend G = iff(Trend, '○', '●'), Tm = format_datetime(T, 'HH:mm')
| extend When = iff(Trend, strcat('~', fd(T)), strcat(fd(T), iff(d <= 30.0 and d >= -30.0, strcat(' ', Tm), ''))),
         InTxt = case(d < 1.0, 'within a day', d < 10.0, strcat('in ', iff(Trend, '~', ''), tostring(round(d, 1)), ' d'),
                      strcat('in ', iff(Trend, '~', ''), tostring(toint(round(d, 0))), ' d')));
let mf = dynamic(['','January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']);
let fy = (t: datetime) { strcat(fd(t), iff(getyear(t) == getyear(nowW), strcat(' ', tostring(getyear(t))), ''), ' ', format_datetime(t, 'HH:mm'), ' WIB') };
let G0 = startofday(A) - 1d * ((toint(dayofweek(A) / 1d) + 6) % 7);
let GL = G0 + 34d;
let GE = G0 + 35d;
let aDay = startofday(A);
let tDay = startofday(nowW);
// the 35 day cells: zone tint relative to the look-ahead date, blue frame on the look-ahead date, grey frame on today
let CB = toscalar(range i from 0 to 34 step 1
  | extend D = G0 + 1d * i
  | extend dd = toint((D - aDay) / 1d)
  | extend P = bag_pack(strcat('c', i, '_d'), strcat(iff(i == 0 or dayofmonth(D) == 1, strcat(dayofmonth(D), ' ', tostring(mn[getmonth(D)])), tostring(dayofmonth(D))),
                                                    case(D == tDay, '  · Today', D == aDay and FF, '  · look-ahead', '')),
                        strcat('c', i, '_b'), case(dd < 0, '26', dd <= 7, '21', dd <= 30, '22', '28'),
                        strcat('c', i, '_h'), case(D == aDay, '3', D == tDay, '5', '9'),
                        strcat('c', i, '_n'), case(D == aDay, '3', dd < 0, '5', '30'))
  | summarize make_bag(P));
// chips: every dated event in the 5 weeks + a prep reminder 7 days before each known date that is a risk
let EV = materialize(evg | where K != 'carry'
  | extend PS = case(Item has 'pull token', 'renew pull token', Item startswith 'Password', 'Oracle passwords', Item has 'evaluation', 'Windows licences',
                     Item has 'certificate', 'ingress certificate', 'plan the fix'));
let chips = materialize(union
  (EV | where T >= G0 and T < GE
      | extend Cl = replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(Short, 'Oldest data ages out', 'Oldest data out'), 'Windows eval ends', 'Win eval ends'), 'Oracle passwords', 'DB passwords')
      | project T, Ch = iff(Trend, strcat('~ ', Cl), strcat(format_datetime(T, 'HH:mm'), ' ', Cl)), B = iff(Trend, '6', strcat('4', Col)), O = iff(Trend, Col, strcat('4', Col))),
  (EV | where K == 'due' and Status !in ('Planned', 'Info')
      | extend T = T - 7d
      | where T >= G0 and T < GE
      | project T, Ch = strcat('Prep: ', PS), B = '6', O = '7')
  | extend i = toint((startofday(T) - G0) / 1d)
  | order by i asc, T asc
  | extend J = row_number(1, prev(i) != i));
let CH = toscalar(chips | where J <= 3
  | extend P = bag_pack(strcat('c', i, '_', J), Ch, strcat('c', i, '_', J, 'b'), B, strcat('c', i, '_', J, 'o'), O)
  | summarize make_bag(P));
let MO = toscalar(chips | summarize n = count() by i | where n > 3
  | extend P = bag_pack(strcat('c', i, '_m'), strcat('+', n - 3, ' more')) | summarize make_bag(P));
// my look-ahead: next up (3 cards) and later (5 rows) from the look-ahead date on
let NL = materialize(EV | where d >= 0 | order by T asc | take 8 | serialize I = row_number());
let NU = toscalar(NL | where I <= 3
  | extend P = bag_pack(strcat('k', I, '_w'), strcat(When, ' · ', InTxt), strcat('k', I, '_wc'), Col, strcat('k', I, '_n'), What,
                        strcat('k', I, '_s'), case(Status == 'Planned', 'planned: nothing to do', Status == 'Info', 'for information: nothing to do', strcat(Owner, ' · ', Prep)),
                        strcat('k', I, '_o'), iff(Trend, Col, '9'), strcat('k', I, '_r'), iff(Trend, '0', Col))
  | summarize make_bag(P));
let LA = toscalar(NL | where I > 3 | extend L = I - 3
  | extend P = bag_pack(strcat('l', L, '_m'), toupper(tostring(mn[getmonth(T)])), strcat('l', L, '_d'), tostring(dayofmonth(T)),
                        strcat('l', L, '_b'), iff(Trend, '6', strcat('4', Col)), strcat('l', L, '_o'), iff(Trend, Col, strcat('4', Col)),
                        strcat('l', L, '_n'), What, strcat('l', L, '_s'), strcat(tostring(getyear(T)), ' · ', iff(Trend, 'trend', 'known date'), ' · ', Owner, ' · ', InTxt))
  | summarize make_bag(P));
// carried over: bitten, overdue (kept on purpose) and lapsed by the look-ahead date
let CR = toscalar(union
   (evg | where Bitten | extend Pri = 1, Cc = '1',
          Tx = iff(Trend, strcat(replace_string(replace_string(What, ' reaches ', ' past '), ' reach the ', ' past the '), ' since ~', fdd(T)),
                   strcat(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(What, ' expires', ' EXPIRED'), ' expire ', ' EXPIRED '), ' ends', ' ENDED'), ' end ', ' ENDED '), ' ', fdd(T), ' ', Tm))),
   (evg | where K == 'carry' | extend Pri = 2, Cc = Col,
          Tx = case(Item has 'backup', strcat(replace_string(Res, 'SQL Server ', 'SQL '), ' full backup ', nf(Age), ' days old (limit ', LimS, ')'),
                    Item has 'Windows update', strcat(Res, ' Windows updates ', nf(Age), ' days old'),
                    substring(strcat(Res, ': ', Item, ' ', Now), 0, 60))),
   (evg | where Lapsed | extend Pri = 3, Cc = iff(Status == 'Planned', '3', '5'),
          Tx = iff(Status == 'Planned', strcat(replace_string(What, ' lapses', ''), ' lapsed ', fdd(T), ' (as planned)'), strcat(What, ' (', fdd(T), ', for information)')))
  | order by Pri asc, T asc | serialize I = row_number() | where I <= 4
  | extend P = bag_pack(strcat('r', I, '_t'), Tx, strcat('r', I, '_c'), Cc)
  | summarize make_bag(P));
let nR = toscalar(evg | where Bitten or K == 'carry' or Lapsed | count);
let ffv = ffs;
let HD = bag_pack('m_t', strcat('LOOK-AHEAD CALENDAR · ', dayofmonth(G0), ' ', tostring(mf[getmonth(G0)]), iff(getyear(G0) != getyear(GL), strcat(' ', getyear(G0)), ''),
                               ' – ', dayofmonth(GL), ' ', tostring(mf[getmonth(GL)]), ' ', getyear(GL)),
                  'bn_t', iff(FF, strcat('FAST-FORWARD · ', fy(A), ' · the calendar as it would look if nobody acts (known dates exact; capacity and speed from the same straight-line trends)'),
                                  strcat('TODAY · read ', format_datetime(nowW, 'HH:mm'), ' WIB from the risk register · red days = next 7 days, orange days = 8–30 days · pick a stop (top right) or use “Look ahead to” at the top of the board')),
                  'bn_b', iff(FF, '27', '0'), 'bn_c', iff(FF, '2', '9'), 'bn_tc', iff(FF, '2', '5'),
                  'b1_c', iff(not(FF), '29', '9'), 'b2_c', iff(ffv == '7', '29', '9'), 'b3_c', iff(ffv == '14', '29', '9'),
                  'b4_c', iff(ffv == '30', '29', '9'), 'b5_c', iff(ffv == '2026-12-11', '29', '9'),
                  'l_d', iff(FF, strcat(fy(A), ' (fast-forward)'), fy(nowW)),
                  'r_h', strcat('CARRIED OVER by ', fdd(A), ' · bitten, overdue, lapsed', iff(nR > 4, strcat(' (+', nR - 4, ')'), '')),
                  'ft', strcat('Read ', format_datetime(nowW, 'HH:mm'), ' WIB from the risk register; refreshes every 15 minutes. Fast-forward moves the date, not the data. Radar, tiles and register stay on today.'));
